policy: Theoretical relevance is NOT empirical validation of a NAAIL product; no licensed data copied; no finished trial asserted.

project_claims.claim: A source-linked research workflow can help formulate tests of audit evidence gaps.
project_claims.uncertainty: Inspection report information is frequently firm-level; engagement-level deficiencies cannot be inferred without authorized evidence.

project_claims.claim: Human skepticism and false-positive costs should be evaluated when interpreting AI-generated audit alerts.
project_claims.uncertainty: A publication about AI skepticism does not establish real-world PCAOB inspection accuracy.

project_claims.claim: Numerical correctness, temporal leakage, and human-in-the-loop decisions warrant separate evaluation rubrics.
project_claims.uncertainty: These studies do not certify particular IFRS treatments or production readiness.

project_claims.claim: Source-grounded financial reporting and deterministic checks are motivated by published work on generative AI in disclosures.
project_claims.uncertainty: The underlying private implementation is not directly inspectable on public GitHub.

project_claims.claim: AI-derived financial-disclosure measures require validation against independent coding and reporting incentives.
project_claims.uncertainty: Neither ISSB jurisdictional compliance nor sustainability assurance is established by the references.

project_claims.claim: AI disclosure is a distinct construct from actual AI adoption and operational capability.
project_claims.uncertainty: The cited paper is on bank AI disclosure, not agentic AI or IFRS S1/S2.

project_claims.claim: Text classification may over-assign disclosure topics and needs construct-validity checks.
project_claims.uncertainty: The literature does not validate KIWI's specific CAM-Q scoring weights.

project_claims.claim: LLM-assisted scientific analysis requires traceable provenance, disclosure of AI use, human decisions and reproducibility.
project_claims.uncertainty: Conceptual recommendations cannot certify implemented governance or prevent agent failures.

project_claims.claim: AI diffusion and delegation motivate studying implementation costs and organizational heterogeneity.
project_claims.uncertainty: Adoption descriptions are not causal evidence that NAAIL creates measurable cost savings.

project_claims.claim: Synthetic/real data balance and generalization risk must be tested before making fine-tuning performance claims.
project_claims.uncertainty: No real checkpoint, training manifest or clean evaluation holdout is supplied here.

project_claims.claim: Knowledge-graph and logical-verification approaches motivate alternative implementations of model adaptation.
project_claims.uncertainty: The cited methods have not been reproduced in this repository.
